name: Finance for Startups and Entrepreneurs
description: The course would broadly cover a start-up’s financial statements (P&L a/c, balance sheet & cashflow statement), managing cash flows (cash budget), evaluating operating and financial performance (ratio analysis), start-up valuation methods, professional venture capital, harvesting the business venture investment and turnaround strategies for distressed ventures.
